data.content_ref: inline:The ability to 'outrun' failure correlation via high-bandwidth telemetry (SRC_001) reduces to a problem of 'Temporal Clustering' (SCR_002), where the speed of the central response must exceed the propagation velocity of the trigger; this is refuted if the failure vector is a 'zero-day' logic error that is identical across all redundant nodes, rendering telemetry-based shifting irrelevant.
